title: Glossy Glazed Carrots
summary: Carrot coins and sticks simmered covered, reduced hard and tossed with butter and sugar into a glossy glaze, finished with lemon.

ingredients.note: cut into 6 mm coins and short sticks

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: about 2 tbsp; 1 tsp at the start, the rest with the butter

steps.title: Simmer covered
steps.text: Put the carrots, water, salt and 1 tsp of the sugar in the frying pan, cover and bring to the boil over medium-high heat. Lower to medium and simmer for 5 min, stirring once or twice, until a knife tip meets only slight resistance. The lid traps steam so the carrots cook through quickly.

steps.title: Reduce the liquid
steps.text: Take off the lid, turn the heat to high and boil for 1-2 min until only about 2 tbsp of liquid is left. This concentrated, sugary liquid is the start of the glaze.

steps.title: Build the glaze
steps.text: Add the butter and the rest of the sugar and keep tossing for about 3 min. The carrots are done when fully tender and coated in a glossy, light-gold syrup; the butter emulsifies with the syrup so it clings rather than pools.

steps.title: Finish with lemon
steps.text: Off the heat, toss in the lemon juice and pepper; the acid balances the sweetness. Scrape everything into a warm dish, glaze and all, and serve at once.

tips: Cut the carrots to an even thickness so they all finish together.
Watch the pan closely once the liquid is low; sugar goes from golden to burnt quickly.
If the glaze tightens before serving, loosen it with a splash of water over low heat.
A few thyme leaves make a good addition.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water, tossing, until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
